credit.credit-words: O Day of Peace and Gladness
WORDS: Christopher Wordsworth, pub.1862; alt. MUSIC: “Mendebras”; German melody; arr. by Lowell Mason, 1839. Public Domain.

God said, Let there be light. Gen. 1:3 This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it. Psa. 118:24 Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.... Receive ye the Holy Ghost. Jn. 20:19-22; Ac. 2:1-4
